adjudication.rationale: In `addGuestsHandler` the DB update (`prisma.booking.update` creating attendees) happens before the external side effects (`eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` and `sendAddGuestsEmails`). There is no transaction/compensation, and `updateCalendarAttendees` is not wrapped in a try/catch, so if it throws the guests are already persisted but calendar/emails won’t run. On retry, `uniqueGuests` filters out already-persisted attendees and can become empty, triggering `TRPCError({ code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: "emails_must_be_unique_valid" })`, preventing re-triggering of calendar/email updates. This matches the partial-failure cascade described.
